purpose: Complete seven-meter conifer candidate in the user-selected separated, feathery, airy A style. Preserve natural sparsity and sky windows; readable full-tree outline and coherent branch/foliage hierarchy remain required. User style choice does not approve art, defects, runtime or publication. This delivery revision changes NORMAL storage only to normalized SHORT via KHR_mesh_quantization; FLOAT32 positions, indices/order, materials and transforms are exact. Independent r19 A art direction was communicated as passed upstream; normal16 appearance and full production/runtime gates remain separate.

criteria.description: Validate shipped static GLB, official format validation, scale/origin, exact geometry/texture budgets and provenance.

Judge the actual exact-GLB pixels in the user-selected A style: readable whole-tree outline, coherent branch/spray growth, clean joins and no coarse tubes or toy-like broad hard blades. Natural airy foliage and sky windows are intended; do not fail solely for not matching the B opaque-mass preference.
Compare every diagnostic anatomical/botanical/geological feature with cited sources and label reconstruction uncertainty.
Verify the frozen brief, complete deliverables and all explicit constraints.
Parse this exact GLB with the pinned target loader and record bounds, materials and errors.
Render this exact GLB in the target graphics runtime; inspect frames and capture renderer/device and measured work.
Render the intended composed scene including this exact GLB; inspect scale/contact/material consistency and measure scene work.

Unchanged dominant trunk, curved lateral boughs and subordinate needle sprays form a readable intentionally open conifer outline, with natural irregular sky windows. Avoid disconnected clutter or all-angle loss of the principal crown structure; sparse A style itself is permitted.
Branch bases taper into trunk with a rounded collar; no plank-like cross sections or detached foliage at detail and underside views.

Separated narrow feathery sprays must organize into a coherent open crown. Fine needle strands may diminish at native128px; the whole tree outline and major branch/foliage hierarchy must remain readable. No requirement for an opaque connected canopy or per-needle visibility at128px.
Delivered labels preserve broad concept status, artistic scale/foliage grouping and modern-analogue limitations.

coverage_justification: 24 fixed-camera azimuth frames plus all orthogonal directions, alternate clay key, triangulated wireframe and visible middle-crown branch joins. Same scale, camera and lighting for original versus revised exact GLB.

claim_scope.taxon: No named extinct species or unchanged modern species claimed
claim_scope.representation: Frozen r17 A narrow bowed needle strips,12 pairs per spray plus one short terminal and thin rachis.149 separated sprays:106 lower and43 upper, including8 added upper sprays. Intentionally airy rather than connected B core surfaces; group sizes/counts and7m scale are artistic.

component_and_cause.primary: Continuous unchanged r12 wood: tapering trunk,26 curved primary boughs, natural broken lower branch and open pyramidal outline.
component_and_cause.secondary: Lower106 sprays use paired nearby attachments with modest opposing pitch;43 upper sprays inherit the bounded r18 local-cluster arrangement. Varying reach/direction produces continuity with clear sky windows.
component_and_cause.tertiary: A leaf constructor is byte-for-byte source-identical to r17. Each spray has24 narrow gently curved side strips, one short terminal and thin green rachis; no connected opaque core, thick green tube or hard ridge-filled broad blade. Small upper twig supports are reported separately.
component_and_cause.quiet_region: Exposed lower trunk and open main-branch roots.
component_and_cause.gaps: Retained broken lower bough, unequal tier heights and natural spaces between fine sprays. These are intentional style, not an opacity defect by themselves.
